_about: xrv_labels.json - the mapping from torchxrayvision DenseNet's 18 output
channels to the SNOMED CT finding each channel means.
xrv's DenseNet('densenet121-res224-all') emits 18 sigmoid values in a
FIXED channel order with no 'No Finding' class. This table names, for
each channel, the finding that channel predicts, so SR-DX-SCOORD-torchxrayvision.py can attach a
coded subject to every number instead of an opaque channel index.
EVERY CODE HERE WAS CHECKED against a public terminology server, not
recalled. See 'source' on each row and the 'verification' block below.
The prompt that asked for this file named 44169009 as an example for
Atelectasis; that code is in fact 'Loss of sense of smell', which is why
no code in this file is taken from prose or from memory.

note: The HL7-run public terminology server was the only one of the obvious
candidates that answered. The others were unreachable on the day:
browser.ihtsdotools.org/snowstorm returned 410 Gone,
clinicaltables.nlm.nih.gov/api/snomedct/v3 returned 404, BioPortal
returned 403, VSAC returned 404. The 'version' above is what the
server itself reported for each $lookup.
xrv's 'Hernia' channel is the NIH ChestX-ray14 label for a
diaphragmatic hernia, which is what this concept names. The generic
term 'Hernia' surfaced only 'Hernia sac' (112640005) and 'Hernia
belt' (17306006), neither of which is a finding; the specific
concept is the correct one.
SNOMED CT has no concept for 'opacity of lung' as such. The nearest
verified concept is 1217294009 'Ground glass opacity'. The other
candidate, 717978008 'Bilateral lung opacities on plain chest X-ray',
is worse: it asserts bilaterality and a modality. 'meaning' therefore
carries the model's OWN class name, and this row is marked as an
approximation so a reader is never told the concept IS the label.
SNOMED CT has neither 'enlarged mediastinum' nor a combined
cardiomediastinal concept. The nearest verified concept is
363646005 'Widened mediastinum' (synonym 'Mediastinal widening').
'meaning' carries the model's own class name and the row is marked
as an approximation.

backlog.item: Lung Opacity and Enlarged Cardiomediastinum are approximations
detail: Both rows are marked 'nearest (related)' rather than 'exact'. If the
site needs a true concept, the candidates are: submit a request to
SNOMED International for the missing concepts, use a radiology
extension (e.g. RadLex Playbook or the DICOM CID 3604/3605 context
groups) instead of the international edition, or keep the value
uncoded and let the meaning carry the label. Not resolved here
